classes.name: Z-drug hypnotics
classes.description: Zolpidem IR/ER/SL (Ambien, Ambien CR, Edluar), eszopiclone (Lunesta), zaleplon; ramelteon (Rozerem) and low-dose doxepin (Silenor) may be listed as alternatives.
classes.plainDescription: A bedtime pill for trouble falling or staying asleep.

classes.name: Orexin receptor antagonists
classes.description: Dual orexin receptor antagonists: suvorexant (Belsomra), lemborexant (Dayvigo), daridorexant (Quviviq).
classes.plainDescription: A newer bedtime pill that blocks the brain's wake signal.

classes.name: Benzodiazepines and buspirone for anxiety
classes.description: Benzodiazepines (alprazolam IR/ER, lorazepam, clonazepam, diazepam, chlordiazepoxide, clorazepate) and the non-benzodiazepine anxiolytics buspirone and hydroxyzine as alternatives.
classes.plainDescription: A medicine for anxiety or panic attacks.

records.verificationNote: Tier 2 and QL 30 per 30 days for zolpidem 5 mg read by x-coordinate on page 82. No PA or step. Judgment: 5 mg is the labeled starting dose; the 10 mg strength is also Tier 2 and is not picked as the default. Controlled substance, so the quantity limit is recorded in preferredRestriction. Ambien, Ambien CR, Edluar, Lunesta and Silenor brand names are not listed. Zaleplon is not in the guide, and doxepin appears only at 10 mg and higher capsule strengths, so it is not an alternative. [Sonnet check 2026-10-27: Re-confirmed against Humana formulary 26402, v17 (updated 10/01/2026), sources/humana-premier-rx-pdp-newtopics-2026-10.pdf (tier, PA, ST, QL read by x-coordinate; the v16 copy used in the first pass is superseded). Pages, tiers and flags match v17.]

Belsomra 5 mg, 15 mg and 20 mg are the same product, so they are not alternatives. Dayvigo (lemborexant) and Quviviq (daridorexant) do not appear anywhere in the guide. The guide does not state it is complete, so they are not recorded as excluded and no other orexin antagonist is listed as covered. [Sonnet check 2026-10-27: Re-confirmed against Humana formulary 26402, v17 (updated 10/01/2026), sources/humana-premier-rx-pdp-newtopics-2026-10.pdf (tier, PA, ST, QL read by x-coordinate; the v16 copy used in the first pass is superseded).
